records.words: I remember sending two sacks by accident and never getting to answer at the fire. I want to try answering somebody this time.
Straight to Çoban. I remember Yusuf being proud about the grain. No accidental sacks this time.
The phone has a tiny map but big buttons. Now it actually says how long I am here. I want to open the house, not squeeze Zehra while she feeds her own family.
Oh! A line I can actually say. Yes, I came to listen.

I got to say I came to listen at Çoban, which is what I wanted last visit. It displayed my fuller sentence, but I have not seen her answer it yet. The clock now says 08:30 and tells me reading slows time. The phone buttons are big; the map is tiny and my travel sentence gets cut off. This note is late after my wait crossed sixty seconds.
Come in is in the notebook, not next to what I said. I cannot tell whether that is his answer or just the visit greeting. I am checking the house again.
I will send one sack on purpose. She asked who feeds her family, and that is still a better answer than insisting.
Sent grain. Good, that is clear immediately this time. I do not need to tap it again.
The gift was clearer, but my listening sentence has not led to a conversation. I am looking at two unavailable orders while the walk home crawls.
Or thank God for us instead. Ha, I like him swerving the landowner out of his thank-you. That has more personality than nine versions of after my own barley.
Survey visitors sound different. Let me see if they have something other than barley to say.

I would leave now. I have said I came to listen twice, but I am not getting a conversation to play with. The visits feel like waiting for a greeting, then walking home. I will keep going for the time I set aside.
Five minutes in, I am briefly checking the wider screen for the requested layout comparison.

Wait, Yusuf Usta is 74 and advises digging, and Meryem is here. That sounds like the old dig-master and the woman who rolled my door in Warren. I did not recognise Yusuf from the name alone. Now I am fairly sure, from the age and digging. Why are you calling me the landowner’s man? I made you a door! I am guessing these are the same people; I have not checked anything outside this page.
Recognising the possible Warren visitors woke me up for a moment. They still gave me one greeting, and I am back to the same barley replies. The quit wish has not passed.
I am waiting after Sit down and nothing more has followed. I understand the visit countdown now, but watching it run out is not interesting to me.
One more house. I want to see whether I can answer somebody who is still refusing my timing, rather than a visitor who owes nothing.
Say what you came to say. I already did! My line is right there under it. I cannot tell if they heard it or whether these are two separate things happening beside each other.
Four visits have given me greetings and the same line to say. I am not curious about the next house now. I would still leave, even though I can finally see the day moving.
I have given it the fifteen minutes. I liked one grain reply and recognising possible familiar people, but I am ready to close this. Waiting longer did not make me want the next visit.

Stopping at home on 18 July at 20:00. My quit wish did not pass. I got to say I came to listen, but I never felt that somebody answered that sentence. I would close it, not leave it running. I would not return voluntarily tonight or plan another evening. Seeing possible Warren people was a nice surprise, but it did not make these visits feel like conversations. Feedback has both stopping and confused; I selected stopping locally and it filled the box itself. Nothing typed or submitted, and consent unchanged.
